audit.independent_solution: Let CD=BD=d. Put C=(0,0), A=(6,0), B=(0,2d). Since CP⊥AD, projection gives P=(6d²/(d²+36),36d/(d²+36)). BP²=4d²(d²+9)/(d²+36)=4, hence d⁴+8d²−36=0 and d²=−4+2√13. Thus AB²=36+4d²=20+8√13, so AB=√(20+8√13).
